currentDecision.priceDiscipline: 31.5 at -115 or better only. Do not chase 32.5+.

freshCandidateReview.reason: Action likes the Over and PFF projects 220.3, but the projection advantage is modest relative to price and recent-game distribution is highly dispersed. Public context also shows a sub-market median near 192-195 across Dart's recent games. Existing Dart rushing Over already captures the negative-script/dropback thesis, so additional same-game exposure is not justified without a stronger probability edge.

Action cites seven straight games with 15+ receiving yards, but an independent Covers model projects only about 15.5 yards. That small central-tendency gap does not establish the required 4-5 percentage-point fair-probability edge at -111.

Week 1 role was strong despite limited snaps: 31% target share, 36.4% first-read share, 69 receiving yards, and expected route growth. However, numberFire/FanDuel Research projects 60.58 receiving yards, below 63.5, so the price-adjusted Over edge is not robust enough for a formal bet.
